definition: Sustained rates measured on this device by TileArena's empirical roofline calibration (protocol tilebench-empirical-roofline/2). Not vendor datasheet theoretical peaks. Copied unchanged from the frozen calibration profile; no calibration was rerun.

meaning.meaning: sustained streaming bandwidth of device memory (read+write copy probes), working sets far above the last-level cache

memory_bandwidth.probe_api: torch copy_/fill_ + Triton SM streaming kernels

notes: value/unit are the profile's SI values (FLOP/s, OP/s, byte/s); value_scaled/unit_scaled are the same value divided by 1e12 (TFLOP/s, TOP/s) or 1e9 (GB/s) and rounded to 2 decimals, for reading only.
role 'scoring' = rates used by the LLM protocol's T_SOL = max(F / P_mode, Q / BW); role 'control' (gemm_fp32_ieee) is an empirical reference, never a ceiling.
The legacy tilebench/data/peak_performance/B200.json (datasheet compute peaks + measured copy bandwidth) uses a different definition and is kept unchanged.
